scope: Real compiled strict TCG Advanced UI: full catalogue, forbidden/regional eligibility, actual native summon procedures, public surrender, lawful siding, reload and next native Duel.
limitations: Only the recorded duels and registered Decks are certified; not the entire card-interaction universe.
Public model flags, own stats and visible projections are checked; source geometry 1:1 and transient attack pixels are not claimed.
The Xyz procedure records the two own public field IDs and actual material choices; there is no separate DOM overlay list to inspect.
No Swiss clock path is certified by this driver.
